about_the_game:
This is a universe where humans and gods coexist. Countless independent world domains of various sizes are distributed in the endless void.

Long ago, a powerful force in a big world abandoned some backward territories and people in order to quickly obtain a divine weapon. In the end, they obtained the divine weapon as they wished. For the powerful ones, a slight loss is irrelevant. They are as strong as ever.

Exactly as the moon waxes only to wane. A long time later, this force encountered equally powerful opponents, and both sides were caught in a dilemma. Just as this powerful force was at a loss, they suddenly learned a piece of news. The people who were abandoned by them back then miraculously established their own small world independently and possessed a divine weapon. So they eagerly connected to that small world, generously expressing their willingness to accept them as subjects again and keep their divine weapon safe for them.

The people in that small world sternly rejected this demand for 'tolerance'. So, this powerful force prepared to send troops to directly eliminate the disobedient people and seize their divine weapon.

At this moment, a god who was indifferent to the world paid attention to this matter. He issued an oracle to summon messengers from other universe to represent him in stopping the rampant behavior of this powerful power.

One day, you unexpectedly received an oracle and arrived in a strange universe. You need to operate 4 heroes to complete the task on this oracle.

Action guide:

  • Arriving in a small world, find General Simon and solve the beast tide problem first.

  • Defend the position and resist frequent invasions from powerful enemies.

  • According to General Simon's request, collect the 12 components of a divine weapon.

  • Finally, cross over to the enemy's world domain and directly slay their leader.

  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Core i7-6700K

short_description: The gameplay is similar to the storyline RPG map of Warcraft III, with 4 heroes operated, 1 melee+3 ranged, exploring the map, triggering the plot, upgrading by fighting, defending towers. Complete the main task to clear the level.
